notes: The site was found at the published coordinates: Mound F with the conserved granary, working floors and quarters is at the north of the protected area and Mound AB south of it, west of the modern town of Harappa. Zoom 19 is not available here; points are measured on the current image (Vantor Vivid, 20250523, zoom 18, about 0.51 m per pixel). Wayback releases 45441, 64776, 32553 and 10842 were viewed for identification; the conserved structures appear in all of them, displaced by up to about 30 pixels between releases. Seven of the twelve points lie on conserved Harappan structures (exposed masonry); the fit without them rests on the Muslim tomb and the four corners of the excavation enclosure on Mound AB. No orientation statement was read for this plan.
